events.title: 황해도 평산에서 태어나다
events.description: 황해도 평산군에서 태어났다. 어릴 때 서울로 옮겨 한학을 배웠다.
events.description_en: He was born in Pyongsan County, Hwanghae Province. His family moved to Seoul while he was young, and he studied classical Chinese learning there.

events.title: 배재학당에 들어가 신학문을 접하다
events.title_en: He entered Baejae School and encountered Western learning
events.description: 스무 살에 선교사 아펜젤러가 세운 배재학당에 들어가 영어와 서양 학문, 정치사상을 배웠다.
events.description_en: At twenty he entered Baejae School, founded by missionary Henry Appenzeller, and studied English, Western learning, and political thought.

events.title: 독립협회에서 개혁운동을 이끌다
events.title_en: He led reform activity in the Independence Club
events.description: 독립협회에 참여해 만민공동회에서 총대위원으로 활동하며 개혁을 촉구했다.
events.description_en: He joined the Independence Club and served as a delegate at its mass public assemblies, pressing for reform.

events.title: 고종 폐위 음모에 연루되어 옥살이하다
events.title_en: He was jailed on suspicion of a plot against the emperor
events.description: 고종을 폐위시키려는 음모에 가담했다는 혐의로 붙잡혀 오 년 칠 개월을 감옥에서 보냈다.
events.description_en: He was arrested on suspicion of involvement in a plot to depose Emperor Gojong and spent five years and seven months in prison.

events.title: 미국에서 박사학위를 받다
events.title_en: He earned a doctorate in the United States
events.description: 조지워싱턴대에서 학사, 하버드대에서 석사를 마치고 프린스턴대에서 박사학위를 받았다.
events.description_en: He completed a bachelor's degree at George Washington University, a master's at Harvard, and a doctorate at Princeton.

events.title: 상해 임시정부 초대 대통령이 되다
events.title_en: He became the first president of the Provisional Government
events.description: 상하이에서 대한민국 임시정부가 세워지자 초대 대통령으로 추대됐다.
events.description_en: When the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea was established in Shanghai, he was chosen as its first president.

events.title: 임시정부 대통령직에서 탄핵되다
events.title_en: He was impeached as president of the Provisional Government
events.description: 임시의정원이 그를 대통령직에서 탄핵했다. 이후에도 미국에서 독립운동 외교를 이어 갔다.
events.description_en: The Provisional Assembly impeached him from the presidency. He continued diplomatic efforts for independence from the United States afterward.

events.title: 광복 후 귀국하다
events.title_en: He returned to Korea after liberation
events.description: 일본이 항복한 뒤 미국에서 귀국해 신탁통치 반대와 남한 단독정부 수립을 주장했다.
events.description_en: After Japan's surrender he returned from the United States and pushed for opposition to trusteeship and the establishment of a separate southern government.

events.title: 대한민국 초대 대통령에 취임하다
events.title_en: He was inaugurated as the first president of South Korea
events.description: 대한민국 정부 수립과 함께 초대 대통령으로 취임했다.
events.description_en: With the founding of the Republic of Korea's government, he was inaugurated as its first president.

events.title: 한국전쟁을 대통령으로서 치르다
events.title_en: He led the country through the Korean War as president
events.description: 북한군의 남침으로 시작된 한국전쟁 내내 대통령으로 재임하며 전시 정부를 이끌었다.
events.description_en: He served as president throughout the Korean War, which began with the North Korean invasion, leading the wartime government.

events.title: 4·19혁명으로 대통령직에서 물러나다
events.title_en: He stepped down as president after the April Revolution
events.description: 부정선거에 항의하는 시위가 전국으로 번지자 대통령직에서 물러났다. 곧이어 하와이로 떠났다.
events.description_en: As protests against a rigged election spread nationwide, he resigned the presidency and soon after left for Hawaii.

events.title: 하와이에서 죽다
events.description_en: He died in exile in Hawaii.
